title_zh: 根据现场封闭告示选择开放步道

scenario.label_zh: 根据现场封闭告示选择开放步道
scenario.goal_zh: 读取低处步道的封闭信息并选择告示列为开放的山脊路线

context_zh: 虚构旅行情景。游客在入口阅读当日假设告示：低处路线关闭，山脊路线开放；不提供实际潮汐时间或路线安全保证。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: The lower trail is marked closed. Does the notice say why?

sentences.speaker: Callum
sentences.text: It says the tide covers part of it, and that the closure is still in place.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: Then we shouldn't try to work out a crossing time ourselves.

sentences.speaker: Callum
sentences.text: The ridge route is listed as open, although the terrain looks rougher on this map.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: Let's take that route slowly instead. We can turn back if it doesn't suit us.

sentences.speaker: Callum
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll put the shore map away; we're not using that path today.
